platform: KTRU 96.1 Rice University Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KTRU explicitly accepts only physical music submissions in CD, LP or 7-inch format and publishes separate USPS and UPS addresses. A human must choose the carrier, verify the current addressing details, prepare the physical release and package, and may use the Music Director contact form only for questions rather than as a substitute for the physical route.

platform: WCBN 88.3 University of Michigan Hard-Copy Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WCBN accepts music from musicians who send a hard copy, preferably CD or vinyl, and asks genre-specific releases to be addressed care of the relevant director. A human must prepare the physical media, choose the appropriate genre destination, verify the mailing address and ship the package.

platform: WNUR 89.3 Northwestern General Manager Music Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WNUR publishes gm@wnur.org and a general contact form but does not explicitly publish a music-submission policy, accepted formats, download-link rules or recipient for new releases. A human must send a limited pre-submission inquiry without attachments or music links and wait for authorization before delivering any material.

platform: WNMC 90.7 Genre Music Director Contact-Form Route
manual_review_reason: WNMC directs record companies and anyone contacting a Music Director to write through the Station Manager form, who forwards the message to the appropriate genre director. A human must select the best-fit director, prepare a concise rights-cleared inquiry, complete the public form and wait for delivery instructions before sending music.

platform: WTBU Boston University Music Directors Album Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: WTBU explicitly asks artists interested in sending an album to contact the Music Directors at wtbu.musicdirectors@gmail.com, but does not publish accepted audio formats, attachment limits, cloud-link rules, metadata fields, clean-edit requirements or release windows. A human must prepare the pitch, confirm the preferred package and avoid unrequested large attachments.
